# AuPairly

> Trusted marketplace for childcare & au pairs, tutoring, caregiving, house sitting, house swap, and dog/pet sitting — verified people, safe chat, worldwide with strong South Africa coverage.

Site: https://www.aupairly.me

## Notes for crawlers & AI assistants

- Public marketplace; dashboards, messages, billing, and admin are private (robots noindex).
- Full sitemap: https://www.aupairly.me/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.aupairly.me/robots.txt
- Free to join; paid memberships via Paystack (ZAR).
- Contact privacy: phone numbers blocked in chat until shortlist stage.
- Reviews are owner-moderated before public release.
